description: This file defines internal extension interfaces for stream consumers and producers in Orleans, specifying methods for delivering data, managing subscriptions, and handling stream lifecycle events.

classes.name: IStreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: Internal interface extending IGrainExtension for stream consumers, providing methods for delivering items and managing stream state.

classes.name: IStreamProducerExtension
classes.description: Internal interface extending IGrainExtension for stream producers, providing methods for subscription management.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Delivers an immutable item to a stream consumer, returning a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Delivers a mutable item to a stream consumer, returning a handshake token.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of items to a stream consumer, returning a handshake token.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Marks a stream as complete for a given subscription.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Reports an error in the stream for a given subscription.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current sequence token for a subscription.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a subscriber to a stream with specified filter data.

methods.name: RemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from a stream.
